title: The Workshop — Activities
subtitle: Try free-form work, collect a prepared display, and trigger a scripted event.

locations.name: Hub
locations.description: Late light falls through the tall windows. A message on the desk asks for a missing notebook. Bring it to Ada, or meet her in the Meeting Room to explain the delay.

locations.name: Workshop
locations.description: An orderly room of unfinished projects. A notebook and a brass token sit on the workbench.

exits.reason: Deliver the notebook or speak to Ada at the meeting to open the shortcut.

locations.name: Meeting Room
locations.description: Three chairs surround a circular table. Ada arrives at shift 4 and returns to the Hub at shift 8; the schedule repeats every 12 shifts. If you miss her, you can wait for the next meeting.

exits.reason: The workshop shortcut is still locked.

locations.name: Quiet Room
locations.description: A private place to pause as the next part of the day begins.

actors.name: Ada
actors.description: An adult project coordinator with a precise manner.
examples: I don't need it perfect. I need it finished. Perfect is a bonus.
Good. Then we have forty minutes, not an hour. Let's use them.
That's... actually rather lovely. Don't tell anyone I said so.
actors.goal: Recover her notebook or agree a revised plan.
actors.backstory: Ada organizes the workshop and is preparing a surprise display for Brin.
actors.voice: Measured, practical sentences; warmth appears after trust.

actors.name: Brin
actors.description: An adult maker with an easy smile.
examples: Look at this joint. No glue, no screws. Took me three tries and one splinter.
Honestly? I'd rather build it wrong once than talk about it for an hour.
actors.backstory: Brin restores old mechanisms and hopes the upcoming exhibition will bring the workshop attention.
actors.voice: Direct, conversational, fond of concrete details.

actors.name: Cyra
actors.description: An adult organizer reviewing the agenda.
examples: Sawdust on your sleeve. Busy morning?
actors.backstory: Cyra keeps notes for the meeting but does not intrude on private plans.

facts.text: Ada needs her notebook. The meeting is another way to resolve the delay.
Ada plans a surprise exhibition for Brin.
The meeting was moved to shift 4.

quests.name: Resolve Ada’s missing notebook
quests.hint: Give Ada the notebook, or talk to her in the Meeting Room.
quests.rewardText: The workshop shortcut is now open.

objects.name: Workbench drawer
objects.description: Behind the loose panel lies a hidden brass token.

objects.name: Bulletin board
objects.description: A hand-lettered notice advertises an exhibition on the following evening.

lorebook.text: The workshop was once a clockmaker’s shop; the brass tokens marked finished pieces.
An open house is planned for the next evening. Ada hopes to show Brin’s work.
Ada has quietly prepared a surprise display for Brin.

daypart.event: The workshop open house starts tomorrow evening.

hangouts.plan: Review the exhibition plans with Ada

activities.name: Prepare exhibition display
activities.description: You finish preparing the exhibition display. The display is ready for the open house.

activities.name: Work a workshop shift
activities.description: You spend a shift tending the workshop and checking supplies.

scriptedScenes.title: The finished display
scriptedScenes.opening: The exhibition display stands ready. Ada pauses beside it, taking in the work you completed.

choices.label: Tell Ada it is ready
choices.result: Ada hears that the display is ready.

effects.text: The player prepared the exhibition display and showed Ada the finished work.
